what: Four tall accent-color tiles covering the hero rest for 1.05s, then from the left at .2s intervals each shrinks to its own center in .5s (scale 0, power1.out) and vanishes — when the last tile is gone, fx:done fires (hook the back image and slogan entrance to it). With once: session, reopening in the same tab ends immediately with no cover
needs: CustomEase (when giving a curve as values)

options.count: Number of tiles (created when there are no child tiles), default 4
options.dur: Time (s) for one tile to shrink, default .5
options.ease: Curve — GSAP name or ”0.25,1,0.5,1”, default power1.out
options.once: ”session” skips it once it has been seen in the tab (sessionStorage)
options.[data-fx-part=tile]: (if present) hand-placed tiles — otherwise creates as many as count
options.fx:done: When fully open the panel fires (bubbles) — then data-done is attached to the panel and it hides

from.where: index.html .h-hero__tiles (four yellow tiles — original app.js: tiles delay 1.05 · .5s · scale 0 · stagger .2, GSAP default power1.out. When done, the star graphic, player and slogan follow in, and if sessionStorage is_animated is set, it skips via the skip label)
